card.name: Partway through names and numbers
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle of a name, number or term, where the next piece is expected to finish it. Examples are the "Fa" in Fauci, the "5" in 50 copies, and the "p" in p53.

modes.label: Split names and terms
modes.description: The first piece of a proper name or lab term that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: NIAID director Dr. Anthony<< Fa>>uci said in a statement today.

modes.label: Inside numbers and thresholds
modes.description: A digit, decimal point or space inside a lab value or time span, just before the rest of the number.
modes.example: HIV-1 RNA less than <<5>>0 copies per mL

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a name or number that is not finished yet.
